user.title: Set up Reorder
user.description: Configure Reorder shopping-list routing. Orders are queued locally until explicitly submitted.

init.title: Manage Reorder
init.description: Choose what you want to manage. Products are matched against the Home Assistant shopping list.

menu_option_descriptions.add_product: Choose a shopping-list name, exact product, quantity, and up to two substitutes.
menu_option_descriptions.edit_product: Change products already approved for Reorder.
menu_option_descriptions.remove_product: Delete an approved product from the catalog.
menu_option_descriptions.zinc_settings: Set Zinc credentials, test/live behavior, and delivery address.

add_product.title: Add reorder product
add_product.description: Set what Reorder should match and queue. Saving this product does not place an order.

data.name: Product name
data.product_id: Preferred product URL or retailer ID

data_description.name: Name on your shopping list, such as Coffee.
data_description.aliases: Alternative shopping-list names, separated by commas. For example: coffee beans, ground coffee.
data_description.retailer: Zinc supports purchasing. Kroger and Other are catalog placeholders in this release.
data_description.product_id: For Zinc, enter the full retailer product URL. For Kroger, use the product identifier/UPC.
data_description.substitute_1: Alternative product URL to try if the preferred product is confirmed out of stock.
data_description.substitute_2: Another approved product URL if the first substitute is also unavailable.
data_description.quantity: Number of units to order each time. Example: 2 bags of coffee.
data_description.max_price: Maximum combined amount for the order, including shipping and tax; also applies to substitutions.
data_description.cooldown_hours: Prevent repeat orders within this period. 168 hours equals 7 days.
data_description.enabled: Turn off to stop Reorder from matching this catalog entry.

data_description.product: Select the approved catalog item you want to change.

zinc_settings.title: Zinc settings
zinc_settings.description: Use a zn_test_ key for sandbox orders. Live mode permits actual spending only through an explicitly confirmed action. Shipping details remain in Home Assistant storage.

data_description.zinc_api_key: Use a Zinc sandbox key while testing. Keep API keys out of Git.
data_description.zinc_live_enabled: Leave off during development. Enabling live mode can permit real orders through a separately confirmed action.

batch_settings.title: Batching schedule
batch_settings.description: Scheduled and rolling modes ONLY prepare a batch for review; they never purchase automatically. Monday=0, Sunday=6. Time uses Home Assistant local time.

data_description.strategy: Manual requires you to prepare batches; weekly and rolling only mark batches ready.
data_description.weekday: Only used for weekly schedule. Sunday=6.
data_description.hour: Only used for weekly schedule. 10 means 10:00 AM.
data_description.rolling_hours: Only used for rolling schedule, e.g. 48 means two days.
